pages.text: A LITERAL block holds a fixed value.$(br2)Right-click it with an empty hand. Pick the type and enter the value. A literal can be a BOOLEAN, INTEGER, FLOAT, CHAR, STRING or TIME. The block is an octagon, so you can tell it apart from a LABEL.
Put a white wool block in the middle and eight NOOP blocks around it. You get eight LITERAL blocks.
The text notation writes literals like this: $(1)TRUE$(), $(1)42$(), $(1)3.14$(), $(1)'a'$(), $(1)"Hello"$() and $(1)@2026-10-19T12:05:09Z$().
